correctness.rationale: Complete analytic proof: strict derivative unimodality yields unique worst curvature; at the critical multiplier the stationarity graph remains strictly increasing with nonzero third derivative and a signed one-third cusp. Above, two folds delimit three stationary branches and strictly decreasing energy difference proves a unique equal-energy input with exactly two global minima. Uniform quartic rescaling gives explicit jump and fold-window asymptotics, and singular-vector alignment lifts the counterexample to spectral rank-one problems. A standalone standard-library verifier checks numerical finite examples without substituting for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Resolves a motivated gap in the sharpness of a practical scaled-proximal uniqueness safeguard: the exact critical multiplier is single valued but ill conditioned, and every larger multiplier produces global nonuniqueness at exactly one input. Critical exponents and leading constants quantify the onset of distinct output singular values, a meaningful structural issue for spectral regularization rather than a routine bound.
